scope: Only HTML files directly in cc-hub, gemini-hub, gpt-hub, grok-hub and muse-hub. Source subdirectories were not imported or changed.
filenamePolicy: GameTitle-SOURCE-model-effort-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.html. Preserve explicit artifact dates and times; use source-file modification time or Gemini export timestamp when absent. Fallback times are not claimed generation times. Existing duplicate destinations retain their established URLs.
metadataPolicy: Use explicit source notes and filename configuration labels. Gemini defaults to Gemini 4 Argon and Muse to Muse Wonder 1 unless explicitly labelled otherwise. Unknown model/effort metadata stays unset. Catalogue metadata is separate from the unchanged packaged game content, except normal intake library localization.
datePolicy: Arrival dates are the actual intake time. Source dates and filename timestamps are retained separately; timestamp component provenance is recorded per artifact. Timezone defaults to America/Vancouver for source labels without a zone.
variantPolicy: Different bytes are not proof of successor lineage. Four uncertain same-title variants are separate entries on the Unsure shelf, with all prior destinations preserved.

verification.method: Static package, provenance, metadata and destination review; catalogue regenerated by intake.

unusedCompatibilityAliases.explanation: The importer adds WebGPU/TSL aliases even for Three.js 0.160.0, which does not ship those builds. Merry-Go-Kart imports only three and three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js; both are present. The extra aliases are unused.

dependencyPolicy: Known Three.js/Rapier versions use the local shelf. Exact unsupported CDN versions are retained. The Super Mistral extra import-map match is an escaped documentation example, not live HTML.
